Privacy

How your details are handled

Last updated 17 August 2026

Who is responsible

This site is run by Mateja Vasojevikj (vasosofuji), a freelance photographer based in Skopje, North Macedonia. For anything on this page, write to contact@vasojevich.com.

What is collected

What you type into the booking form:

  • Your name, if you choose to give it, since the field is optional.
  • Your email address.
  • Your phone number, if you choose to give it, since that field is optional too.
  • The date you selected, the kind of shoot, and anything you write in the message fields.

Separately, the site counts page views through Vercel Analytics so I can see which work people actually look at. It records the page, the referring site, and a rough country and device type. It sets no cookies, follows nobody across other websites, and never receives your name, your email or anything you typed. There is nothing in it that identifies you, and there is no way for me to tie a visit back to a person.

There are no advertising trackers and no third-party cookies on this site. Nothing is stored in a database.

Why, and on what basis

Your details are used to reply to your enquiry and arrange a shoot. The lawful basis is your request, meaning steps taken at your request before entering into a contract.

Separately, the form has a checkbox asking whether I may contact you if you start a booking but do not finish it. It starts ticked, and you can untick it at any point while the form is open. If it is ticked when you leave without submitting, the details you had entered are sent to me so I can follow up. The lawful basis is your consent. If you untick it, nothing is sent when you leave.

Where it goes

Enquiries reach me through two services, and nowhere else:

  • Formspree delivers the completed form to my email inbox.
  • Telegram notifies me about unfinished enquiries only, and only where the checkbox above was left ticked. A booking you actually send is never passed to Telegram.

Vercel hosts the site and provides the page-view counts described above. It sees the ordinary request information any web host sees.

All three are processors acting on my instructions. Your details are never sold, and are not shared with anyone else.

How long it is kept

Enquiries stay in my email and Telegram history for as long as needed to deal with the booking and any follow-up work, and are deleted on request at any time.

Your rights

You can ask for a copy of what I hold about you, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, withdraw your consent, or object to how it is used. Email contact@vasojevich.com and I will action it. Withdrawing consent does not affect anything done before you withdrew it.

If you are unhappy with how your details were handled, you can complain to the Agency for Personal Data Protection of North Macedonia, or to your local supervisory authority if you are in the EU or UK.
